definitions.gloss: sound of an explosion; blast; loud bang
definitions.explanation: The noise produced by an explosion or sudden violent burst. Commonly used in news reports, witness accounts, and descriptions of accidents or fireworks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{爆発音|ばくはつおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆発音|ばくはつおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: The neighborhood residents were startled by the explosion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧{爆発音|ばくはつおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧。
examples.english: Window panes in the vicinity were shattered by the explosion that rang out in the middle of the night.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧ (explosion) + {音|おん} (sound). Used both for actual blasts and for loud explosion-like noises.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆発音|ばくはつおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear an explosion
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{爆発音|ばくはつおん}: a loud explosion
- {爆発音|ばくはつおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: the sound of an explosion rings out
- {爆発音|ばくはつおん}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧: along with the explosion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{爆音|ばくおん}→爆音：15070_bakuon⟧: roar (of engines/explosions) — broader, includes loud engine noise
- {破裂音|はれつおん}: bursting sound — for ruptures, balloon pops, etc.
- ⟦{銃声|じゅうせい}→銃声：28328_juusei⟧: gunshot — sharper, specific to firearms
